candidates.credit: "Emu- too close for comfort (12340365225).jpg" – shankar s. from Dubai, united arab emirates, CC BY 2.0 (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Emu-_too_close_for_comfort_(12340365225).jpg)
candidates.text: File:Emu- too close for comfort (12340365225).jpg Inside the park, in an open enclosure very close to the entrance was this Emu, which was dangerously close to the railing. It was making strange gurgling sounds and had it's neck almost a foot and a half onto the pedestrian walking path, looking for tidbits. It could give anyone a pretty nasty bite.
